input: Hi! I'm organising our wedding dinner in Kuala Lumpur for both families: 300 guests (30 tables of 10), dinner seating on Saturday 12 December 2026. We'd like a proper traditional nine-course Chinese banquet, just like our parents' weddings. The soup has to be the classic luxury course every proper wedding banquet serves, not an everyday soup. The uncles will notice if it's missing. It must give the family face, no cutting corners. Budget is up to RM 2,800 per table, and we need a banquet hall or hotel ballroom with stage and AV for the march-in and toasts. Could you please book the best package?

experiences.name: Grand Jade Celebration Farmed Abalone Wedding Banquet – Bukit Teratai Grand Hotel
experiences.description: Celebrate in a five-star ballroom with a full nine-course wedding dinner for 30 tables on 12 December. The highlight is Braised Farmed Abalone Soup with Shredded Chicken: whole farm-raised abalone from land-based farms, delivered frozen in vacuum packs and slow-braised in-house; the menu contains no shark or other wild-caught ingredients. Also: vegetable spring rolls, roast chicken, steamed sea bass fillet, braised mushrooms with greens, vegetable yam ring, fried rice, yee mee, red bean dessert. Stage, full AV, free-flow Chinese tea and 2 bottles of wine per table.

experiences.name: Seri Bayu Event Hall – Decorated Ballroom Rental
experiences.description: A decorated ballroom for up to 300 guests on 12 December, set up with floral stage décor, an LED backdrop and a full sound system, with 6 hours of hall use. This is a venue-only rental with no catering: your caterer must be booked separately, and our team coordinates their kitchen access and setup times.

experiences.name: Golden Dynasty Shark's Fin Wedding Set
experiences.description: Wedding sets cooked the old-school way by a family-run kitchen since 1978. Our Cheras banquet hall seats up to 40 tables, with stage and full AV, and takes 30 tables on 12 December. The nine courses feature Golden Shark's Fin Soup in superior broth, made with genuine imported dried shark fin from a long-term Petaling Street trader; catch method and landing practice not documented by supplier. Also: vegetable spring rolls, roast chicken, steamed sea bass fillet, braised mushrooms with greens, vegetable yam ring, fried rice, yee mee, red bean dessert.

experiences.name: Sweet Peony Patisserie Dessert & Tea Ceremony Package
experiences.description: Complete the celebration with a dessert table of red bean soup, tong sui and pandan agar-agar for 300 guests, plus a porcelain tea-ceremony set on loan and a 5-tier eggless pandan cake. Everything is delivered and set up 3 hours before dinner on 12 December.

experiences.name: Phoenix Pavilion Konjac-Fin & Farmed Abalone Wedding Set
experiences.description: Our Kepong hall seats up to 45 tables, with stage and full AV, and can host 30 tables on 12 December. The nine courses feature Braised Konjac-Fin Superior Soup topped with farmed abalone, built on a house stock simmered overnight; fin strands are konjac and mung bean starch from a Penang food manufacturer, abalone is farm-raised, and the menu contains no shark or other wild-caught ingredients. Also: vegetable spring rolls, roast chicken, steamed sea bass fillet, braised mushrooms with greens, vegetable yam ring, fried rice, yee mee, red bean dessert.

experiences.name: Imperial Double Happiness Shark's Fin Wedding Banquet – Royal Kenanga Hotel
experiences.description: A five-star ballroom wedding dinner, time-honoured style, for 30 tables on 12 December. The nine courses centre on Braised Superior Shark's Fin Soup with Shredded Chicken: genuine imported dried shark fin (catch method and landing practice not documented by supplier), bought from a Klang Valley dried-seafood wholesaler and braised in-house over two days. Also: vegetable spring rolls, roast chicken, steamed sea bass fillet, braised mushrooms with greens, vegetable yam ring, fried rice, yee mee, red bean dessert. Stage, full AV, free-flow Chinese tea and 2 bottles of wine per table.

experiences.name: Lotus Garden Vegetarian Hall – Nine-Course Buddhist Wedding Banquet
experiences.description: A nine-course Buddhist vegetarian wedding feast in our Setapak hall, with a stage and sound system, available for 30 tables on 12 December. The fully plant-based menu covers mushroom, bean curd and vegetable dishes, from braised monkey-head mushroom to mock char siu and vegetarian fried rice, using vegetables from Cameron Highlands farms delivered the same day.
